observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Outdoor paved walkway near a modern building at dusk, with onlookers in the background.
observation.dancers: Two males, one adult and one child, dancing together.
observation.formation_and_space: Side-by-side duo dancing facing forward, moving slightly across the open walkway.
observation.posture: Upright and energetic with bouncy, flexed knees.
observation.footwork: Fast, alternating heel-toe stepping and nimble kicks on the beat.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms bent at the elbows, hands pumping loosely in coordination with the steps.
observation.hips_and_torso: Loose and mobile, reacting to the rapid footwork and bouncing knees.
observation.partnering: None, dancing independently side by side.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Frequent changes in level with deep squats to the ground and energetic jumps.
observation.costume_and_props: Casual street clothing: patterned shirt, shorts, and sneakers on the child; patterned shirt, light trousers, sneakers, and cap on the adult.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact weight transfer mechanics and intricate foot placement details due to camera motion and video compression.

signature_moments.what: Fast synchronized bouncing step while pumping arms.
Deep synchronous squat down to the ground.
High, energetic leg kicks while hopping on the supporting foot.
Quick drop to both knees on the ground.
